description: Change a room: replace its shared `data` (users in the room receive it live), its `moderators` list and/or its own inactivity time (`ttlInactivity` in days, 0 = never deleted, null = back to the app's per-type value). Replacing data overwrites the live game state of that room — confirm with the developer first.

data.description: New room data (replaces the whole object)

anyOf.description: Days without activity before Neblla deletes this room (0 = never). Overrides the app's per-type value (rooms.public/private.ttlInactivity: 30 / 90 by default) for this room only.

ttlInactivity.description: Days without activity before Neblla deletes this room (0 = never). Overrides the app's per-type value (rooms.public/private.ttlInactivity: 30 / 90 by default) for this room only.

name: neblla_update_room
